pill.desc: clear, colourless solution in a single-dose prefilled syringe

tell: A receptor-Fc fusion, not an antibody, it neutralises both TNF-alpha and lymphotoxin-alpha and does not lyse TNF-expressing cells.

clues.text: Clearance is about 160 mL/hr after a single subcutaneous dose, and its pharmacokinetics are unaltered by concomitant methotrexate.
A protein of 934 amino acids with an apparent molecular weight of about 150 kilodaltons, supplied as a sterile, preservative-free solution.
A BLA product in 25 mg and 50 mg strengths, given as prefilled syringes, autoinjectors or vials; dosing is weekly or twice weekly.
Boxed warning for serious infections, including tuberculosis, and malignancies. Contraindicated in sepsis; infections and injection site reactions are the most common adverse reactions.
Rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis and plaque psoriasis in adults, plus polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis and juvenile psoriatic arthritis in children.
A dimeric soluble p75 TNF receptor that binds TNF and lymphotoxin, rendering TNF biologically inactive.
The generic name begins with E and has ten letters.
